comment: The toy app's contract (bench/app/CONTRACT.md): what every variant serves, word for word. The TypeScript app (server.ts) has these as constants, checked against this file by test/contract.test.ts; the Go and Python ports read it at start (BENCH_CONTRACT), and the conformance check (src/conformance.ts) holds every variant to it.

event.name: bench.event
event.description: A bench test event for one lane of one run

watch.description: Wake this conversation when a bench event is published.
watch.text: Watching bench events. Each event is one line with a code like WB-<lane>-<n> (WB-, four letters or digits, a dash and a number). They're test messages from the bench, not from the user.

unwatch.description: Stop waking this conversation for bench events.
unwatch.notWatching: This conversation wasn't watching bench events.

report_seen.description: Tell the bench which event codes (WB-…) you've received since you last reported.
